Subject: HelixMed: Aligning Week-0 Runbook & Launch Call Windows

Hi Sofia & Tomas —

Great to meet you both over email. We're excited to get HelixMed into a Week-0 onboarding cadence. To make the first launch call smooth we want to align on: attendee roster, a 60-minute agenda with clear timeboxes, required prework, and the preferred bridge for your team.

Two options that work for Redwood (we'll staff CS + Solution Engineering + an ops host):
- Option A: Tue Oct 5, 15:00–16:00 UTC (convenient for EU + East US)
- Option B: Wed Oct 6, 22:00–23:00 UTC (US West friendly; early EU morning)

Please let us know which you prefer and any attendees to add. Quick asks we have for you before the session:
1) Confirm internal attendees and their roles (product/IT/security).
2) Share any VPN/allowlist info if you want Redwood test accounts to access staging.
3) Fill the attached prework PDF (Helix_Onboarding_Prework.pdf) and put it in the shared Drive by EOD Mon Oct 4.

Draft 60-minute agenda (we're flexible):
- 0:00–0:10 — Introductions & success criteria (customer-owned)
- 0:10–0:25 — Architecture & data controls (HelixMed + Redwood ops)
- 0:25–0:40 — Demo: onboarding flows & integration touchpoints
- 0:40–0:50 — Mutual Action Plan review (see attached Excel)
- 0:50–1:00 — Next steps & owner assignments

Attachments: Helix_Onboarding_Prework.pdf (pdf), Helix_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (xlsx)

If neither option lands, tell us three 1-hour windows next week and we'll propose calendar invites.

Thanks —
Grace
